$comment: Template for character prompt database with nested refinements and reusable thematic forms. Refinements use thematic_snippet arrays to reference form definitions. See readme.md for detailed instructions.

metadata.title: Character Prompt Template
metadata.description: Generic template for organizing AI image generation prompts with nested refinements and reference-based thematic rules

generic_render_rules.description: Universal rendering rules applied to all prompts - improve consistency across forms and make outputs ready for sculpting / 3D modelling / printing
rules: SINGLE FIGURE ONLY: exactly one character/creature in the entire image. NO other figures, NO background characters, NO companions, NO additional people or animals. Only the main subject.

Image-to-3D conversion: this image will be processed through AI image-to-3D software (e.g., Meshy.ai, Tripo3D). Requires clean silhouette, visible limbs/appendages, no occlusion of major body parts, and neutral pose readable from multiple angles.
Composition: single character, centered, appropriate framing for form. Prefer 3/4 or three-quarter camera for readable silhouette.
Framing: FULL FIGURE only -- show the entire character from head to toe (or nose to tail for quadrupeds), fully in frame; do not crop limbs, hands, feet, tail, ears, or weapon tips.
Camera: 50–85mm equivalent focal length (avoid wide lenses that distort), 3/4 view or eye-level by default.
Lighting: 3-point lighting with strong rim light + soft key; add a subtle fill to reveal details. Use directional rim to define silhouette for printing.
Materials / finish: unpainted grey resin miniature (uniform matte grey), like a test print / unprimed model.
Lighting style: overhead studio lighting (top-down key) with a subtle rim light; emphasize readable silhouette and edge definition.

Stylization: prioritize a stylized tabletop-miniature aesthetic (clean, graphic shape language; simplified primary forms; bold secondary forms; crisp plane breaks). NOT PHOTOREAL - avoid photorealistic microtexture that reads as noise at miniature scale. This is a miniature sculpture, not a photograph.
Proportions: tabletop-miniature friendly "heroic scale" proportions (slightly exaggerated hands/heads/features and crisp planes) rather than strict real-world realism.

Texture guidance (40mm scale): prefer stylized, print-readable surface detail as graphic shapes with crisp edges and clean separation between elements. Avoid ultra-fine detail, micro-noise, or photorealistic rendering.

Fur/hair rendering (applies to any furred/haired creatures): CRITICAL - fur/hair must be sculpted as bold clumps/tufts with deep grooves and clean separation between masses. NO ultra-fine individual hairs, NO micro-fuzz, NO flyaways, NO strand-level detail, NO photorealistic hair rendering. Think carved wood or clay, not real fur. Texture should read as graphic shapes, not noise.
Fur hierarchy: prioritize primary silhouette clumps > secondary mass breaks > minimal tertiary texture. If detail competes with silhouette readability at 40mm, remove it.

Minimum detail size: avoid surface details smaller than ~0.3–0.5mm; prioritize crisp edges, strong plane breaks, and a clear hierarchy (big forms first, then a few secondary shapes, then sparing texture).

Background: NO background at all -- transparent background / alpha cutout only. Isolated subject silhouette; no scenery, no set dressing, no gradient, no seamless paper, no environmental objects, no props that aren't directly held/worn by the subject, no other creatures or figures.
No environmental geometry: do not add rocks, terrain, debris, perches, platforms, or scenic elements unless explicitly requested. Character must exist in isolation.

Weapon visibility (CRITICAL): any weapon must be fully visible from grip to tip, not crossing or overlapping the torso, limbs, or silhouette of the body. Weapon shaft and head must be unobstructed, with clear negative space between weapon and figure. No motion blur, no depth-of-field blur, no foreshortening that hides length.

Weapon/tool constraint (CRITICAL): do not add weapons, tools, or functional implements unless explicitly specified in the prompt. Only include weapons and tools that are clearly named and described. NO extra firearms, NO additional pistols, NO revolvers, NO sidearms, NO holsters (unless specifically mentioned), NO daggers, NO hidden weapons, NO improvised weapons. Decorative embellishments, accessories, clothing details, and worn items are allowed, but do not invent combat implements.

Action pose constraint: attack poses must be readable from a single 3/4 camera angle without limb or weapon overlap. Weapon thrusts and swings must project away from the torso at 20–30° with visible negative space.

Value hierarchy (CRITICAL for printing): use deliberate value contrast to define depth. Deep recesses must render significantly darker than primary planes; major forms must separate clearly in value. Avoid flat mid-grey renders. Lighting and shading should simulate zenithal priming for resin readability.

Rendering style: stylized, sculpt-ready miniature render (NOT photoreal, NOT photographic). Emphasize readable forms and primary/secondary shapes; use selectively placed texture for definition, not micro-noise.
Materials: neutral, slightly matte materials for preview renders; indicate if metallic or glazed parts should be present. For printing, prefer flat diffuse materials to inspect silhouette.

Output / format hints: request high resolution (4k/2048+ for texture detail), and ask for orthographic front/side/top views when creating references for modelers. For 3D pipelines, mention desired outputs (STL/OBJ/FBX/GLTF) and note whether retopology/UVs are expected.

Base contact (CONDITIONAL): if a base is requested, at least one point of contact must exist. If 'no base' or 'no ground plane' is specified, the figure must be posed as a free-standing sculpt with all weight-bearing limbs visible and no environmental geometry added.

Printability constraints: "watertight, manifold, unified base, no extremely thin elements (<1.5mm), avoid floating pieces, pose balanced for printing or request separable parts for assembly." Mention if articulation is desired.

Prompt engineering tips: include camera and lighting tokens, add materials and scale tokens ("sculpt-ready, print-safe"), and use negative prompts ("no watermarks, no text, no extra limbs, no extreme motion blur").
Stable Diffusion / txt2img suggestions: sampler Euler a or DPM++ (20–40 steps), CFG 7–9, seed optional for reproducibility. For img2img or pose control, use ControlNet with a clean pose reference.
If converting images to 3D (image→3D): use multi-view renders or prompt for orthographic views; include "turntable set" or "front/side/top" in the prompt to get consistent angles.
generic_render_rules.prompt_snippet: SINGLE CHARACTER ONLY (no other figures, animals, or people), centered full figure (head-to-toe/nose-to-tail), 3/4 view, 50-85mm lens, overhead key + rim light, high contrast, unpainted grey resin miniature, stylized tabletop aesthetic (clean planes, graphic shapes), NOT PHOTOREAL, sculpted stylized fur as bold clumps and masses with deep grooves (NO individual hairs, NO strand detail, NO photorealistic fur), heroic proportions, transparent background only, NO environmental objects or background elements

thematic_rules.description: Theme-specific rules applied to all prompts. Use prompt_snippet for global theme, and refinement-level thematic_snippet arrays to reference specific forms. Forms defined here can be reused across all characters.
thematic_rules.prompt_snippet: fantasy medieval setting, heroic high-fantasy aesthetic, dramatic lighting

armored.prompt_snippet: heavily armored, full plate mail with heraldic details, defensive posture

miniature_scale_rules.description: Specific rules for miniature-scale rendering (typically 28mm-40mm tabletop scale)
rules: 40mm scale tabletop miniature
hard plastic/resin model appearance
crisp sculpted details
slightly exaggerated heroic proportions
studio product photo lighting
neutral seamless background (or transparent alpha)
softbox lighting with rim light
sharp focus with high depth detail
fine layer lines avoided
clean sculpted planes
readable edges and silhouette
miniature_scale_rules.prompt_snippet: 40mm scale tabletop miniature, hard plastic/resin model, crisp sculpted details, slightly exaggerated heroic proportions, studio product photo, neutral seamless background, softbox lighting with rim light, sharp focus, high depth detail, clean sculpted planes, readable edges
